nodes.name: careers.csv
nodes.summary: Seed data listing career tracks (e.g. Frontend, Backend) with id, optional prerequisites, and a descriptive text, used to populate the career catalog for the roadmap platform.

nodes.name: roadmap_nodes.csv
nodes.summary: Large seed dataset (189 rows) defining the hierarchical roadmap tree for each career: nodes carry skill group, stage, axis, node kind, optionality/checkpoint flags, selection rules, weights, completion policy, required proficiency, evidence keywords, parent/previous linkage, description, and reference links, forming the structure of learning roadmaps shown to users.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-referential tree structure via parent_id/previous_id columns encodes ordering and hierarchy of roadmap nodes per career.

nodes.name: skills.csv
nodes.summary: Seed data mapping skill names to a career track and an importance rating (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), used to drive skill relevance/weighting within each career's roadmap.
